title: Canadian Poutine Wraps
description: A delicious twist on traditional poutine, served in crispy wraps.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
2. Cut the potatoes into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes and fry until golden brown.
3. Warm the Canadian wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Assemble the poutine by placing the fried potatoes on the warmed wrap, followed by your favorite toppings.
